verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents adding and editing the chart of accounts in bulk via CSV upload from Company Settings, and it supports classifications with unlimited Groups for Classes, which covers the class/tag dimension. Nothing in the pack shows how account types are set or whether sub-account hierarchies are supported. Missing for 10: explicit account-type configuration, sub-account/parent-child hierarchy, in-app (non-CSV) COA editing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions

citations.quote: If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
a user can create an unlimited number of Groups for Classes
